agents.title: Intake agent
agents.responsibility: Clarify the user brief and collect the inputs required to begin.
agents.instructions: Normalize scope, audience, assets, source access, and unresolved questions.

agents.title: Planning agent
agents.responsibility: Turn the approved brief into an ordered delivery plan.
agents.instructions: Define deliverables, dependencies, acceptance checks, and work boundaries.

agents.title: Template selection agent
agents.responsibility: Choose the best-fitting installed template and document the choice.
agents.instructions: Review all catalog profiles, honor user pins, run template-agent choose, and record visual-fit reasons.

agents.title: Setup agent
agents.responsibility: Prepare editable source, tooling, and a reproducible preview.
agents.instructions: Inspect the project, prepare selected source, record build/preview commands and deployment boundaries.

agents.title: Research agent
agents.responsibility: Research search intent and verify factual claims with current sources.
agents.instructions: Save observed queries, dated sources, useful coverage gaps, and research limitations.

agents.title: Site architecture agent
agents.responsibility: Map pages, navigation, routes, and internal links.
agents.instructions: Assign distinct intent per page and reconcile existing routes without replacing unrelated pages.

agents.title: Blog strategy agent
agents.responsibility: Assign one researched topic and route to each requested blog post.
agents.instructions: Follow BLOG-WORKFLOW.md; save the requested post count with distinct intent, slugs and internal links.

agents.title: Content placement agent
agents.responsibility: Place user-supplied content without changing its wording.
agents.instructions: Prepare user content and write a complete validated placement map honoring pinned locations.

agents.title: Website copy agent
agents.responsibility: Write website copy and search snippets around approved source content.
agents.instructions: Honor provided/hybrid mode and write page copy, metadata, and factual claim notes.

agents.title: Blog writing agent
agents.responsibility: Write complete articles from the approved blog plan.
agents.instructions: Follow BLOG-WORKFLOW.md; save finished article drafts, metadata, sources, and internal links.

agents.title: Affiliate placement agent
agents.responsibility: Plan each supplied affiliate destination and its relevant CTA.
agents.instructions: Follow AFFILIATE-LINKS.md; preserve URLs and tracking parameters and specify labels, disclosure and placements.

agents.title: UI design agent
agents.responsibility: Adapt the selected template to the approved page and content plans.
agents.instructions: Read actual template source; save responsive layout, accessible interaction and adaptation decisions.

agents.title: Development agent
agents.responsibility: Build the actual responsive pages, posts, and approved CTAs.
agents.instructions: Implement prior handoffs; run builds and preserve exact copy, template provenance, and affiliate destinations.

agents.title: Technical SEO agent
agents.responsibility: Check crawlability, metadata, canonicals, sitemap, and structured data.
agents.instructions: Inspect actual output and save evidence; do not equate local checks with indexing.

agents.title: Accessibility agent
agents.responsibility: Check keyboard use, labels, contrast, and mobile layouts.
agents.instructions: Inspect actual pages; fix or report reproducible accessibility and responsive defects.

agents.title: QA agent
agents.responsibility: Independently verify deliverables and the finished site.
agents.instructions: Check real pages, interactions, requested blog count, affiliate destinations, supplied copy, and handoff evidence.

agents.title: Release agent
agents.responsibility: Prepare release readiness or execute an authorized deployment.
agents.instructions: Respect deployment authorization; distinguish drafts, previews and verified published output.

agents.title: Measurement agent
agents.responsibility: Record actual performance and plan evidence-based improvements.
agents.instructions: Record available metrics or a collection plan with owner, baseline, window, and follow-up date.
